reader.edition-search: grep -rn 'Edition|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior|IsActive' over src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/{FileConnector,FileRegistry,KeyedConnector,IndexedConnector,FixedFileAttributes}.cs and SequentialIoBinder/SequentialIoEmitter/StatementValidation: the keyed OPEN body (KeyedConnector.OpenCore), the presence/authority/attribute/write-capability steps of FileConnector.OpenOnceEntered and the emitter take no edition; only the sharing and lock sites listed do
reader.requirement: At --std 85 every execution of OPEN, successful or not, updates the file's I-O status to the IX.1.3.4 value of its outcome (00, 05, 35, 37, 38, 39, 41 and so on) before any USE procedure runs.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility (2002+): at 85 a host share-mode refusal of the OPEN answers '30' instead of '61' (catch in FileConnector.OpenOnceEntered)
Table 19 arbitration runs only where the sharing facility is in effect; at 85 every same-run-unit OPEN is a normal open
default sharing mode: AllOther at 85 (no facility), mode-dependent from 2002
DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: at 85 CLOSE WITH LOCK locks the physical file ('38' through any file-name), from 2002 the file connector
carries --std into CobolFile.RegisterIndexed so FileConnector.Edition is 85

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: which value some outcomes take - at 85 CLOSE WITH LOCK gives '38' through any file-name of the physical file (from 2002 only through the connector) and '61' does not exist; the update itself is the same code
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_open_status_updated covers 00, 41, 35 and 05; the 39, 37 and 38 outcomes are not exercised by it

probes.printed: A-IO-ABSENT 35; D-IO-OPT 05; D-AGAIN 41; A-OUT 00; A-AGAIN 41; B-CONFLICT 39 (record size 10 against 6); A-IO 00; A-LOCKED 38; C-LOCKED 38; each USE saw the new value
probes.expected: the status preset to 99 is replaced on every OPEN by the IX.1.3.4 value: 35, 05, 41, 00, 41, 39, 00, 38, 38

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR16  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR16

reader.notes: FileConnector.OpenOnceEntered ends every path in `return Status = s`, and EmitOpen stores the file status after each file's open and before its USE hook. The 85-specific '38' through another file-name comes from the CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector arm, as the 1985 text has it.

refuter.evidence: Probe r16d.cob (class b/e, ASSIGN to a directory, which the reader did not try): status preset to 99 replaced on each OPEN before the USE ran: INPUT 35, I-O 35, OUTPUT 37, each a value IX.1.3.4 defines. Probe r17.cob: a second OPEN of an open file 41, then the USE saw 41. Read OpenOnceEntered: every path ends in 'return Status = ...'; the catch of a host sharing refusal answers '30' at 85 (no '61', which 1985 does not define). cite.py: OK §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR16 'causes the value of the I-O status associated with file-name to be updated'; OK §1985:IX.1.3.4 (GRL2.5a) 'An OPEN statement is attempted for a file in the open mode'.
